title: ModHarness-RL: Recasting Harnesses as Learnable and Evolving Programs for Agentic RL
abstract: arXiv:2611.18533v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly relies on a harness, the scaffold around the model that decides what it sees of its own interaction and what guidance it receives. Most existing approaches train under a hand-written harness that stays fixed throughout. However, an effective harness depends on the domain, the data and the model, and keeps changing as the model trains. We introduce ModHarness-RL, which recasts the harness as programs that are learned from data and evolve as the model trains with RL. ModHarness-RL records the interaction as structured State, a set of typed blocks, and two core components of the harness are programs over these blocks, a Compression program that assembles the accumulated history into the model's context and a Steering program that supplies guidance when behavior deviates. During RL training, candidate programs are proposed from recent trajectories, verified by execution, and replayed over past

translated_title: ModHarness-RL：将支架重构为可学习、可演化的程序以服务于智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 智能体强化学习（RL）日益依赖于一个“支架”，即围绕模型的脚手架，它决定模型能看到自身交互中的哪些内容，以及模型会接收到什么样的引导。大多数现有方法都在一个全程固定不变的手写支架下进行训练。然而，一个有效的支架取决于领域、数据和模型本身，并且会随着模型的训练而持续变化。我们提出 ModHarness-RL，它将支架重构为从数据中学习、并随着模型通过强化学习训练而不断演化的程序。ModHarness-RL 将交互记录为结构化的状态，即一组带类型的块，而支架的两个核心组件就是基于这些块的程序：一个压缩程序，负责将积累的历史组装进模型的上下文中；一个引导程序，在行为发生偏离时提供指导。在强化学习训练过程中，候选程序从最近的轨迹中被提出，通过执行进行验证，并在过去的（轨迹上）进行重放。
tldr: 提出 ModHarness-RL，将智能体强化学习中固定不变的手写支架重构为可从数据学习并随训练不断演化的程序，通过压缩程序（组装上下文）和引导程序（行为偏离时提供指导）两个核心组件，从轨迹中提出候选程序并经执行验证而持续进化。
en_tdlr: ModHarness-RL recasts the fixed hand-written harness in agentic RL into learnable, evolving programs — a Compression program that assembles accumulated history into context and a Steering program that provides guidance on deviation — with candidate programs proposed from trajectories, verified by execution, and replayed during training.
